description: "Bell's Cathedrals: The Cathedral Church of Salisbury" by Gleeson White is a historical account written in the late 19th century. This work provides an in-depth exploration of the architectural features, fabric, and historical significance of Salisbury Cathedral, a landmark of Gothic architecture in England.
